proposals.name: llm_volume_confirmed_short_term_reversal_6d74a4ba
proposals.economic_logic: Short-term price overreactions on high trading volume reflect temporary liquidity shocks rather than structural fundamental shifts in sector funds.

proposal_metadata.hypothesis: ETFs experiencing strong 5-day price pullbacks backed by high volume confirmation are more likely to undergo a mean-reverting bounce relative to CSI 300 over short horizons.
failure_modes: Strong structural regime shifts where high-volume selling represents real fundamental deterioration
Broader market panic causing broad sector contagion regardless of short-term volume dynamics

proposals.name: llm_risk_adjusted_trend_efficiency_a88f29a0
proposals.economic_logic: Smooth, efficient upward trends driven by persistent inflows outperform erratic, highly volatile momentum spikes when penalised for tail volatility risk.

proposal_metadata.hypothesis: Industry ETFs exhibiting high trend efficiency and 20-day momentum scaled down by short- and medium-term volatility generate superior risk-adjusted cross-sectional excess returns.
failure_modes: Sudden sector rotation out of low-volatility momentum leaders into beaten-down value sectors
Macro trend reversals causing sharp drawdowns in high trend-efficiency leaders
